answer: Each identity binds one state-issued service record, verified against the registry: the cedar record names person, unit, months; one record backs one identity, duplicates rejected. Weight begins after 180 days service and a 240-unit fee on the umber trail: each fake costs one person, 180 days, 240 units. Re-checked each epoch; a sold record dies when check-ins fail. Cheapest cheat: pay a stand-in to serve as you, but check-ins bind the record to them, not you; a forgery fails the registry match and risks fraud. 100 fakes need 100 people, 18,000 days, 24,000 units — a delta no script shrinks.
